description: This file defines a PHP service class 'CustomFieldService' used within the OrangeHRM system to manage custom employee fields, including generating field keys, getters/setters, extracting field numbers, and handling related data cleanup tasks.

classes.name: CustomFieldService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to handle custom employee fields, including generating field keys, getters, setters, extracting field IDs, and managing related employee data.

methods.name: getCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Provides an instance of CustomFieldDao, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: generateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Generates getter method names for specified custom field numbers.

methods.name: generateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Creates a field key string for a given custom field ID.

methods.name: generateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Creates a setter method name for a given field key.

methods.name: extractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Extracts numerical field IDs from an array of field key strings.

methods.name: deleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraData
methods.description: Removes specified extra data from employee custom fields if no longer used.

methods.name: getAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Returns a list of custom field IDs currently in use, up to 10.
